purpose: Verify classification of document-tree vs record-store archetypes, patch obligations, and unknown blocking (MSV-004).

archetypes.definition: Executive artifacts are structured documents in a directory or hierarchy (e.g., POSIX filesystem).
archetypes.patch_realization: In-place document edits of the executive document.
archetypes.compact_behavior: No-op success when no deltas exist.
conforming_scenarios: Editing specific sections or criteria of an executive document in-place.
Preserving unaffected documents within the executive context untouched.
nonconforming_scenarios: Rewriting unaffected documents across the context.
Introducing quadratic write amplification or full context directory rewrites.

archetypes.definition: Discrete observations, items, or records storing memory (e.g., Engram MCP, KV store, SQLite record table).
archetypes.patch_realization: Executive journal: base record + ordered deltas + context-head slot.
archetypes.context_head_cardinality: Exactly one context-head per executive context.
archetypes.compact_behavior: Rolls up deltas into a new base and updates context-head.
conforming_scenarios: Appending a single delta record to the journal and updating the context-head pointer slot.
Leaving base record, catalogue, other contexts, and other executive bodies unchanged during patch.
nonconforming_scenarios: Monolithic full-object overwrites of executive artifacts on spec draft iterations or execute task updates.
Rewriting the patched object's base record on every patch operation.
Relying on contract 1.0.x full-update compatibility path to evade journal requirements in a 1.1.0 package.

archetypes.definition: Unclassified, contradictory, or absent archetype in a 1.1.0 package.
archetypes.handling: Stop immediately; no conforming mapping can be generated.
rules: Do not infer document-tree or record-store from backend name, tool server name, or vendor.
Pre-dimension 1.0.x packages must be explicitly classified during upgrade; unknown blocks 1.1.0 certification.
